# Vendored code

## `inventory.py`

Vendored verbatim from [GetCassis/dbt-agent-readiness](https://github.com/GetCassis/dbt-agent-readiness)
(`scripts/inventory.py`, release v1.6.1, commit `9ec55a7`), MIT licensed — see `LICENSE`
in this directory, which is that project's license file.

It is the dbt parser: compiled-manifest vs source-only handling, dialect detection,
`{% docs %}` resolution, tests, refs and SQL column extraction. `adapters/dbt.py`
imports it from here.

**Vendored rather than imported.** Loading it from any path outside this repo
would mean a fresh clone silently has no dbt adapter at all; the test suite
asserts it stays vendored.

**Do not edit this file.** Fixes belong upstream, then re-vendor: copy `scripts/inventory.py`
and `LICENSE` over, update the release and commit above, and run `python3 tests/test_kit.py`.
